generated_at.description: Deterministic: equals corpus_as_of, the newest incident date (YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z); not the build time. Kept under this name for existing consumers of the 1.0 contract.

corpus_as_of.description: The newest incident `date` in the corpus at build time, as YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z. Identifies the corpus snapshot; it is not the time the file was built.

incidents.description: Each element is a full validated incident record (incident.schema.json).
